kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتكافأ (form VI)
# أَتَكَافَأُ (ʔatakāfaʔu) /ʔa.ta.kaː.fa.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# أَتَكَافَأَ (ʔatakāfaʔa) /ʔa.ta.kaː.fa.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# أَتَكَافَأْ (ʔatakāfaʔ) /ʔa.ta.kaː.faʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
